choices.text:
The loop at lines 9–12 follows `default_table` pointers without rechecking that each new `j` is within bounds (the check at line 6 only applies to the initial state), and without any cycle detection, so a differential state whose parent chain loops (or points to another differential state unchecked) causes an out-of-bounds read or infinite loop. The bug is introduced by following the parent without validating it.

Answer: 11
